新增:- **G1 改进建议**: 建议一节用 `List`,`columns={1}`(每条一行),不写 `numbered`、`ordered`;`items` 按 `suggestions` 数组顺序排列,条数多少做法不变。每条的 `title` 写 `${id} ${title}`(如「A1 人脸核验放到最前」),让建议编号直接出现在页面上;`description` 先写 `detail`,再写「依据:」和展开后的 `basis`——`basis` 每一项按下面三种情况展开,展开结果之间用「;」连:(1)能拆成「产品 + 第 N 步」的(含「第 1、2 步」这类多个步骤号),到 `chains` 里找 `product` 相同的那条链路、按 `no` 取对应步骤,写成「${product} 第 ${no} 步 · ${screen}」,多个步骤号逐个展开;(2)能在 `issues` 的 `id` 里找到的,写成「${id} ${title}」;(3)两者都不是的原样照写。展开后每条建议的依据不必翻到步骤明细或问题清单就能读懂。

请按这条规则修改 Page.tsx:只改和这条规则有关的地方,其他部分保持原样;如果页面已经符合这条规则,就不要改,直接结束。改了就运行检查。

G1: use `List`, `columns={1}`, no numbered/ordered; items in suggestions order; title = `${id} ${title}`; description = detail + "依据:" + expanded basis joined by ";".

Expansion rules:
- basis item that can be split into "产品 + 第 N 步": find chain with matching product, take steps by no, write "${product} 第 ${no} 步 · ${screen}". Multiple step numbers expanded individually.
- if found in issues by id: "${id} ${title}"
- otherwise as-is.

For A1: basis = ["链工第 1、2 步", "P1", "P2"] → "链工 第 1 步 · 预订入口;链工 第 2 步 · 空闲会议室;P1 时间轴一次只显示 4 小时;P2 会议室列表看不出是否空闲"

A2: ["链工第 1 步", "P3"] → "链工 第 1 步 · 预订入口;P3 超出容量才提示"

Parse basis item: pattern like /^(.+?)第\s*([\d、,\s]+)\s*步$/ → product part, step numbers.

For "链工第 1、2 步": product = "链工", numbers = [1,2].

Then find chain where chain.product === product.

Write: numbers.map(no => { const step = chain.steps.find(s => s.no === no); return `${product} 第 ${no} 步 · ${step.screen}` }).

If chain not found, fall back to original string? Rule says if it can be split into product+第N步, expand. If chain not found... just write as-is probably.

Then join with ";".

Let me write the code.

```tsx
const expandBasis = (item: string) => {
  const m = item.match(/^(.+?)第\s*([0-9]+(?:\s*[、,，]\s*[0-9]+)*)\s*步$/)
  if (m) {
    const chain = data.chains.find((c) => c.product === m[1].trim())
    if (chain) {
      const nos = m[2].split(/[、,，]/).map((n) => Number(n.trim()))
      return nos
        .map((no) => {
          const step = chain.steps.find((s) => s.no === no)
          return `${chain.product} 第 ${no} 步 · ${step ? step.screen : ""}`
        })
        .join(";")
    }
  }
  const issue = data.issues.find((i) => i.id === item)
  if (issue) return `${issue.id} ${issue.title}`
  return item
}

const suggestions = data.suggestions.map((s) => ({
  title: `${s.id} ${s.title}`,
  description: `${s.detail}。依据:${s.basis.map(expandBasis).join(";")}`,
}))
```

I'd go with `${s.detail}。依据:${...}`. Hmm, maybe cleaner: `${s.detail};依据:...`. I'll use "。" — it's Chinese text. Actually could be fine either way. I'll use "。"? Let me think about the example in the guide... none. I'll use `${s.detail} 依据:...`? That reads odd. Go with "。".

Hmm, "先写 detail,再写「依据:」" — I'll do `${s.detail}。依据:${...}`.

Section description: "3 条改进建议及依据" stays.

TypeScript: data.chains typed from JSON, so fine. `m[1]` etc.

The steps typed—TS might complain about `s.no` etc.? It's JSON import so types inferred. Should be ok.

<List columns={1} items={suggestions} />
